description: On omega, successor never equals zero, is injective, and every nonzero member is the successor of exactly one member.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NaturalNumbersAsSets.omega_peano.{u} :
  (∀ n ∈ ZFSet.omega, insert n n ≠ ∅) ∧
    (∀ n ∈ ZFSet.omega, ∀ m ∈ ZFSet.omega, insert n n = insert m m → n = m) ∧
      ∀ n ∈ ZFSet.omega, n ≠ ∅ → ∃! m, m ∈ ZFSet.omega ∧ insert m m = n
